evidence.title: GRAFT: Graph-Distilled Generative Retrieval for Facet-Aware Scientific Literature Exploration

summary: Researchers introduce GRAFT, a novel AI approach combining graph distillation and generative retrieval to improve facet-aware exploration of scientific literature. The method aims to streamline complex document searches by leveraging structured relationships in academic data.
title: New AI Model GRAFT Enhances Scientific Literature Exploration with Graph-Distilled Generative Retrieval
